caption: ORCA CALL confirmed by ear (D. Edgington), 2015-09-17 06:41 UTC. THE HIGHEST-SCORING WINDOW OF THE ENTIRE CAMPAIGN TO DATE (orca_v10 = 3.128) and a confirmed orca. notes: Label #16, wid=235701. v10 3.128 / v4 1.884. Above v10's 2.31 operating threshold. This grab REPLACES an earlier one (10.29.04 AM) in which a browser tooltip covered the header.
